scope: Production stdio MCP and explicit native-operation fixtures against separate disposable app copies. Per-tool coverage requires actual stdio calls. A tool success alone is not a guarantee for every argument or workflow.
limitations: Counts exclude tool successes from failing fixtures and exclude metadata-only probes.
Geometry-only measurements do not verify viewport rendering.
Unobserved tools are not accepted by this audit, including external services, solvers and manufacturing integrations.
Earlier successful PR #12 scenarios remain separate historical evidence; a current viewport failure is not relabeled as a pass.
Version coverage requires application-connected fixtures. Host-only fixture coverage is recorded separately.
Appearance and section lifecycle fixtures validate native data and history, not rendered pixels; screenshot/manual fixtures remain separate.
Native-viewport fixtures verify freshly rendered WebGL pixels, not HTML labels, CSS panels/backgrounds or operating-system window visibility. Default window capture retains its hidden-renderer guard.
